name: Rampaging Golem
description: Destroy or pacify the Flesh Golem in Strahd's Workshop.

objectives.description: Defeat the Flesh Golem by reducing it to 0 HP or by placing 3 Calm tokens on it.

specialRules.description: When the Workshop is revealed, place the Flesh Golem instead of drawing a Monster.
When a Hero would draw a Treasure Card, they may instead take a random Item token.
Instead of attacking, a Hero on the Flesh Golem's tile may attempt to pacify it by interacting with its items.

introText: The Heroes descend to Strahd's workshop to calm or destroy a rampaging Flesh Golem.
victoryText: The Flesh Golem is defeated! The workshop falls silent, and one of Strahd's greatest weapons is no more.
defeatText: The Flesh Golem crushes its opposition. Strahd's workshop claims another victims.
